messages:
Alex Mendoza: quick idea — can we reduce friction on postmortems by having a light-weight action extraction pipeline?
Priya Singh: yes please. current problem is people write TODOs in comments and they never make it into the action dashboard.
Sam Choi: +1. also want automatic customer-impact buckets (none/minor/major/outage) inferred from the incident timeline. saves triage time. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alex Mendoza: rough proposal: 1) post-incident thread gets a bot summary (timeline + auto-detected actions) 2) actions get created in a central tracker with owners and due dates 3) auto-schedule a short follow-up reminder into owner calendars if they opt-in.
Katie Llane: opt-in calendar scheduling would be huge. can the bot detect OOO from the profile and avoid scheduling?
Priya Singh: we should keep the postmortem template minimal so the bot can parse it reliably. fields: incident id, customer impact, short timeline, root cause hypothesis, actions (owner + due + brief), validation plan.
Sam Choi: sample template idea:```
Incident: <INC-YYYY-MM-DD-XXX>
Impact: outage/major/minor/none
Start: <ts>
End: <ts>
Summary: one-line
Root cause: one-line
Actions:
 - [owner] [due] [status] brief action text
Validation: how we'll confirm fix
```
Alex Mendoza: commands for bot: `@pm-bot create-pm <thread_ts>` -> bot replies with parsed template, lists actions and asks to confirm owners. `@pm-bot extract-actions` -> scans thread for lines starting with ACTION: or - [owner].
incident-bot: detected keywords: "database" "replica lag" "timeouts"; no alerts from billing systems.
pm-bot: parsed 3 actions from thread, created items in PostIncident Dashboard: #P-412, #P-413, #P-414.
Priya Singh: love the dashboard link. fields to show on cards: status, owner, due date, SLA impact, verification criteria, linked playbook link, incident id, slack thread.
Katie Llane: add an automation for stale actions: if owner hasn't updated in 7 days, escalate to on-call lead and add a slack reminder to the thread.
Sam Choi: and a tiny ML classifier that suggests probable owner based on touched services and git blame. not required for MVP but nice-to-have.
Alex Mendoza: operational constraints: bot must be permissive — owner confirmation required before scheduling or creating calendar events. audit log for all auto-moves.
Priya Singh: edge cases: when multiple owners listed or when owner is a pager alias. fallback to team inbox and create a task with tag "unassigned".
Katie Llane: minimal UX: when bot posts extracted actions it should provide quick reactions for each item: :eyes: assign, :white_check_mark: done, :calendar: schedule.
Sam Choi: propose rollout plan: 1) proof-of-concept that detects ACTION: or - [owner] lines and creates cards (2 weeks) 2) dashboard columns + filters (1 week) 3) calendar opt-in + stale escalations (2 weeks) 4) classifier + blame suggestions (sprint after)
Alex Mendoza: metric targets: aim to get >80% of actions created automatically; reduce time-to-ack for actions from median 3 days -> 1 day; reduce untriaged postmortems older than 30 days by 50% in 8 weeks.
Priya Singh: who volunteers to own the PoC? I can take the extractor + parser. Sam take dashboard. Alex will coordinate infra + auth. Katie can own calendar and policy.
Sam Choi: I'll spin up a small dashboard prototype and wire it to a demo Trello/Jira board for quick testing.
Alex Mendoza: next steps: Priya to share a draft parser regex and sample training set (10 past postmortems) by EOD Friday. Sam will post a prototype dashboard link in this thread next Tue. Katie will outline calendar opt-in UX and permission flow.
Katie Llane: noted. also raising a question for legal: calendar scheduling invites with customer-sensitive incident titles may need redaction. I will loop in security/legal.
Priya Singh: example extractor command for testing:```
@pm-bot extract-actions 1978001111 --regex "(?im)^(?:action|todo|\- \[.*?\])[:\s]+(.+)$"
```
Alex Mendoza: cool — leaving this thread as the coordination hub for the PoC. if anyone has objections to scope, speak now or we'll start the workstream next week. :rocket:
Katie Llane: no objections. excited. :thumbsup:
Sam Choi: +1.
Priya Singh: thanks all — putting notes into a GH gist and will link once ready.
incident-bot: archived thread into incident-index (INC-2026-047) for future retrieval.
